evidence: Full tank_core package test suite passes with zero failures across all test binaries (~500+ tests total). cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings clean. cargo fmt --all --check clean.

24 substrate unit tests pass, covering all acceptance criteria: rooted_plants_increase_o2_penetration, root_oxygenation_proportional_to_biomass_with_diminishing_returns, floating_plant_biomass_does_not_increase_penetration, zero_root_biomass_yields_zero_oxygenation_bonus, root_oxygenation_uses_named_parameter, root_oxygenation_dynamic_tracks_biomass_growth_and_decline, root_oxygenation_requires_rootable_substrate_habitats, zero_rol_rate_removes_rooted_oxygenation_effects, fully_oxic_bed_reports_zero_root_oxygenation_bonus, zero_rol_rate_zeroes_root_bonus_but_preserves_root_demand_baseline.

ROL formula verified correct (substrate.rs:111-127): remaining_depth = (total_depth - base_penetration).max(0); bonus = remaining_depth × (1 - exp(-(active_root_biomass × rol_rate) / remaining_depth)). Saturating exponential bounded by remaining available depth. Zero bonus when bed is already fully oxic.
Only PlantGuild::RootFeedingRosette contributes to active root biomass (substrate.rs:168 guild filter). Floating/epiphytic/fast-stem guilds excluded.

rol_rate_cm_per_g is a named parameter in ProcessParams (process.rs:176-189) with serde default 0.15 cm/g, invariant-checked non-negative (invariants.rs:276), and present in default.toml (line 104). Not hardcoded.

step_substrate_zones (substrate.rs:60) uses substrate_oxygenation_breakdown_with_registry(state, &state.habitat_registry), reusing the pre-computed registry in the hot path. Public accessor substrate_oxygenation_breakdown() (line 82-84) and root_oxygenation_active_biomass_g() (line 151-153) fall back to compute_habitat_registry() for standalone/test/tracing calls — addressing amendment fr-6-5c9d4bed.

Denitrification comment at root_zone_oxygenation.rs:131-132 now correctly reads 'planted substrate shifts denitrification because the deeper rooted oxic zone leaves less suboxic volume available near the surface' — addressing amendment fr-6-8b38a232.

estimate_substrate_o2_demand_rate() (substrate.rs:261-262) includes root_demand = active_root_biomass_g × bod_rate × ROOT_RESPIRATION_SUBSTRATE_DEMAND_FRACTION (0.1), restoring the rooted-plant O2 demand baseline. Test zero_rol_rate_zeroes_root_bonus_but_preserves_root_demand_baseline (line 1088) verifies that rol_rate=0 still shows shallower penetration in planted vs unplanted beds — addressing amendment fr-6-e14eeefd.

Tracing output: structured tracing::debug! at substrate.rs:62-72 exposes base_penetration_cm, root_oxygenation_bonus_cm, active_root_biomass_g, effective_penetration_cm as separate named fields. Engine records these as four BudgetMetricUnit entries (engine.rs:509-524). Integration test tracing_exposes_root_oxygenation validates presence.

Engine::from_parts (engine.rs:224-240) now calls state.refresh_habitat_registry() before step_substrate_zones, ensuring initialization uses a current registry, then refreshes again after penetration depths are applied.
findings_or_gaps: Minor: from_parts (engine.rs:231) discards the SubstrateOxygenationBreakdown returned by step_substrate_zones during initialization. Harmless since init-time tracing isn't needed, but a minor API inconsistency with the tick-loop path. Non-blocking.

Minor: The public accessors root_oxygenation_active_biomass_g() and substrate_oxygenation_breakdown() still call compute_habitat_registry() internally. This is by design for standalone/test callers but means test code calling these functions incurs a redundant recomputation. Non-blocking.
follow_up_or_amendments: No blocking amendments required. All acceptance criteria are satisfied. All three final-review amendments (fr-6-5c9d4bed registry reuse, fr-6-8b38a232 comment correction, fr-6-e14eeefd root demand baseline restoration) have been properly addressed in the current code with regression tests.
